Hi Samantha — thanks for the quick primer and for sending the attachments. 

A few notes from procurement/finance side (copying Kimberly and Marissa to confirm AP flow):

1) Legal name / DBA: we can store both fields. Our vendor master requires the "legal_name" match the W9/EIN exactly for 1099 classification. We'll add a distinct "display_name" for billing which can be your DBA.

2) Remit and PO routing: we route POs to the vendor email on file; invoices should land at ap@bluewren.io. For automated matching we prefer the invoice header to include PO#, Redwood PO number, and remit email.

3) Banking: please submit banking via our secure ACH intake form — I'll send the link in a follow-up secure message (we do not accept banking via email).

4) Tax forms: W9 looks OK at first pass — finance will validate the EIN against the W9 and confirm. If there's any discrepancy we may need a scanned certificate of formation showing "BlueWren Technologies, LLC".

Next steps: Kimberly, can you confirm whether we need the MSA signed by BlueWren now or if we route payment and operational onboarding independently? Marissa, please advise on estimated time to activation once the vendor record is created and banking is provided.

Best,
